remarks: Welcome to Hollow Wood. This beautiful and updated 3bd 2ba home, sits in the peaceful and desired neighborhood of Pemberwick, close to several amenities. As you go onto the main level, you'll find spacious open floor living with ample natural lighting, beautiful hardwood floors, updated kitchen with quartz countertops and a center island perfect for entertaining. From the kitchen, head onto the back deck with your morning cup of coffee and relax with the sound of birds or simply enjoy grilling your favorite meal. Upstairs you'll find 3 bedrooms and a full bath which is conveniently located within a few steps from all bedrooms. Enjoy being able to do your own lundry at home, the benefits of having extra storage rooms (Laundry and attic) and large enough driveway for multiple cars.
